fields.Name: ActivitySelectionPageAllowed
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Determines if the Container is in an Activity Workflow and display the Activity Selection Page Popup

fields.Name: ActivityWorkflowAllowed
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Determines if the Container is in an Activity Workflow

fields.Name: ActivityWorkflowValidation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Activity Workflow Validation. True by default. False in ActivityTxn.

fields.Name: CalledByTransactionTask
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: If this transaction is being performed as part of an e-procedure, this is the TransactionTask where it was specified.

fields.Name: Carrier
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing.  Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

fields.Name: Comments
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

fields.Name: CompletionMsg
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error.  The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

fields.Name: Container
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Container against which the service is being performed.  A container is a tracking mechanism used for WIP material processed in the factory.

fields.Name: CurrentActivity
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Store the current activity of the container within the activity workflow that is used to perform container txn

fields.Name: CurrentActivityName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Store the current activity name of the container in the activity workflow that is used to perform container txn

fields.Name: CurrentSpec
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A Spec is used to define the specific processing steps required for the current operation or activity

fields.Name: DataCollectionDef
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData.  If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically.  If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using.  For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes.  When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

fields.Name: DataCollectionDefs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Once the Container is set, this list field is populated with all DataCollectionDef entries matching current service in the Container.Spec.TxnMap. This allows the provision of SelectionValues for ContainerTxn.DataCollectionDef  field so that user can manually resolve the possible DataCollectionDef ambiguity.

fields.Name: DispatchItem
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Facilitates the configuration of dispatching rules for MfgOrders and Containers on Shopfloor services.  Only one entry per dispatch item type will be allowed to be configured.

fields.Name: DispatchRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field represents the existence of an order dispatch type within the dispatch rule, used in the enforcement of the Dispatch Rule.

fields.Name: EnableRPT
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

fields.Name: ESigRequirement
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The signature requirement for the spec/service combination.  Only one should be defined for the combination.

fields.Name: Factory
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The factory where the work was performed.  The container must exist in the factory specified here.  Usually this field is not input by the user.

fields.Name: IsConfirmation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This is flag means that this transaction will execute with confirmation

fields.Name: IsRemoteService
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

fields.Name: MfgCalendar
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

fields.Name: MfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system. 

A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

fields.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

fields.Name: Operation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The operation at which the work was performed.  If required, this field is meant to be used as an edit check to reduce the possibility that a user entered the wrong container name.

fields.Name: Password
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered.  If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

fields.Name: PrintQueue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

fields.Name: ProcessActiveMfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

fields.Name: ProcessESignatures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service.  This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

fields.Name: ProcessResourceStatusModel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Flag used to find and execute a StatusModelDetail with a PreconditionToAutoSet that returns true.

fields.Name: ProcessTimerHistoryDetail
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: ProcessTimerHistoryDetail

fields.Name: RemainingProcessTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

fields.Name: ResourceLastRouteStep
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow.  ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

fields.Name: RPTReset
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: RPTReset

fields.Name: SamplingPlan
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product.  The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

fields.Name: TaskContainer
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: If this service is being performed as part of a e-procedure task, this is the container for which the e-procedure is being processed. This field is used top populate the ExecuteTaskService.Container field, and for ContainerTxns, this will be the same as the Container field. It is needed for the case where the service is not a Container Transaction, e.g. ResourceSetup.

fields.Name: UpdateThruputOnChildRes
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Update Thruput Qty on Child Resources

fields.Name: UseDispatch
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Configures a service to be enabled for using the dispatch functionality

fields.Name: UseMfgNCR
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Use Mfg NCR

fields.Name: UseQueue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Defines the usage of queue at this operation.  If a queue is required, a transaction (MoveIn) must be performed prior to any work being recorded.

fields.Name: User
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation.  If not input, security is based on the login user.

fields.Name: WorkCenter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed.  A work Center contains zero or more operations.

The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources.  A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

fields.Name: ActionSource
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to filter Actions.

fields.Name: AdditionalESigReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Contains the list of ESignature Requirements that should be collected in a single transaction.

fields.Name: AlertMsgList
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string list used holds the additional messages of a transaction

fields.Name: AlertMsgListDelimiter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string field used to define the delimiter string to separate the additional messages

fields.Name: EffectivityDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing.  This value is always specified as GMT time.

fields.Name: EmailGroup
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

fields.Name: Employee
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed.  Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

fields.Name: EnforceDispatch
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

fields.Name: HasDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

fields.Name: HasDPCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

fields.Name: HasUserDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

fields.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

fields.Name: ParametricDataControl
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

fields.Name: ParametricDataDefType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: CDO Definition Id

fields.Name: PrintingResult
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printing Result

fields.Name: PrintLabels
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic Boolean

fields.Name: ProcessEProcedures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessNCRs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place.
Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

fields.Name: SampleQty
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Sample Qty

fields.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test..  For each  Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured.  Resolved from the Container

fields.Name: SpecFilter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

fields.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

fields.Name: TaskTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

fields.Name: TrainingRequirements
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

fields.Name: TxnDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The date and time the service was performed.  If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

fields.Name: TxnParentServiceName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

fields.Name: TxnServiceSequence
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

fields.Name: WebPart
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Unique name for this instance

fields.Name: ACEMessage
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure)
On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

fields.Name: ACEStatus
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure)
Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.

Value Name                 Meaning
1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully
2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully
3 ACEFFail                 an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event
> 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

fields.Name: ServerName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

fields.Name: CurrentDay
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: CurrentMonth
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: CurrentWeekOfYear
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

fields.Name: CurrentYear
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: SmartBarcode
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

fields.Name: SmartScanParseError
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

fields.Name: SmartScanRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

fields.Name: StrSplitResult
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

fields.Name: TxnDateGMT
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: TxnDateGMT

fields.Name: DisplayName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

fields.Name: InstanceID
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

fields.Name: CollectDataPoints
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Collect Data Points transaction is used to collect data points for a trackable object.  It requires that the trackable object have a DataPointCollection assigned to it.

fields.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Current status information of a Container

fields.Name: ESigProcessTimerDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement for Process Timer

fields.Name: LiveRelayInfo
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

fields.Name: WIPMsgMgr
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: WIP Message Manager.  Provides functions for retrieval, acknowledgement and writing to history of WIP messages.

fields.Name: ActionDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: List of actions. It's built based on the ActionType field.

fields.Name: ComputationDetail
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Details of the Computation

fields.Name: ESigDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement.

fields.Name: LabelSummaries
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: When printing labels, the information needed to print as well as the values (details) are resolved and kept here for use later.

fields.Name: ParametricData
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service.  The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.

fields.Name: SmartScanParseResults
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Holds result of parsing one data value from the Smart Barcode

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Free-form text notes the user can provide when performing a service.

fields.Name: Container
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Container against which the service is being performed.  A container is a tracking mechanism used for WIP material processed in the factory.

fields.Name: CurrentActivity
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Store the current activity of the container within the activity workflow that is used to perform container txn

fields.Name: CurrentActivityName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Store the current activity name of the container in the activity workflow that is used to perform container txn

fields.Name: CurrentSpec
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A Spec is used to define the specific processing steps required for the current operation or activity

fields.Name: DataCollectionDefs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Once the Container is set, this list field is populated with all DataCollectionDef entries matching current service in the Container.Spec.TxnMap. This allows the provision of SelectionValues for ContainerTxn.DataCollectionDef  field so that user can manually resolve the possible DataCollectionDef ambiguity.

fields.Name: DispatchItem
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Facilitates the configuration of dispatching rules for MfgOrders and Containers on Shopfloor services.  Only one entry per dispatch item type will be allowed to be configured.

fields.Name: DispatchRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field represents the existence of an order dispatch type within the dispatch rule, used in the enforcement of the Dispatch Rule.

fields.Name: EnableRPT
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

fields.Name: ESigRequirement
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The signature requirement for the spec/service combination.  Only one should be defined for the combination.

fields.Name: Factory
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The factory where the work was performed.  The container must exist in the factory specified here.  Usually this field is not input by the user.

fields.Name: IsConfirmation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This is flag means that this transaction will execute with confirmation

fields.Name: IsRemoteService
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

fields.Name: MfgCalendar
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

fields.Name: MfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system. 

A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

fields.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

fields.Name: Operation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The operation at which the work was performed.  If required, this field is meant to be used as an edit check to reduce the possibility that a user entered the wrong container name.

fields.Name: Password
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered.  If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

fields.Name: PrintQueue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

fields.Name: ProcessActiveMfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

fields.Name: ProcessESignatures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service.  This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

fields.Name: ProcessResourceStatusModel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Flag used to find and execute a StatusModelDetail with a PreconditionToAutoSet that returns true.

fields.Name: ProcessTimerHistoryDetail
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: ProcessTimerHistoryDetail

fields.Name: RemainingProcessTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

fields.Name: ResourceLastRouteStep
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow.  ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

fields.Name: RPTReset
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: RPTReset

fields.Name: SamplingPlan
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product.  The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

fields.Name: TaskContainer
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: If this service is being performed as part of a e-procedure task, this is the container for which the e-procedure is being processed. This field is used top populate the ExecuteTaskService.Container field, and for ContainerTxns, this will be the same as the Container field. It is needed for the case where the service is not a Container Transaction, e.g. ResourceSetup.

fields.Name: UpdateThruputOnChildRes
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Update Thruput Qty on Child Resources

fields.Name: UseDispatch
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Configures a service to be enabled for using the dispatch functionality

fields.Name: UseMfgNCR
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Use Mfg NCR

fields.Name: UseQueue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Defines the usage of queue at this operation.  If a queue is required, a transaction (MoveIn) must be performed prior to any work being recorded.

fields.Name: User
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The user performing the data entry, used primarily for security validation.  If not input, security is based on the login user.

fields.Name: WorkCenter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed.  A work Center contains zero or more operations.

The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources.  A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

fields.Name: ActionSource
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to filter Actions.

fields.Name: AdditionalESigReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Contains the list of ESignature Requirements that should be collected in a single transaction.

fields.Name: AlertMsgList
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string list used holds the additional messages of a transaction

fields.Name: AlertMsgListDelimiter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string field used to define the delimiter string to separate the additional messages

fields.Name: EffectivityDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing.  This value is always specified as GMT time.

fields.Name: EmailGroup
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

fields.Name: Employee
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed.  Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

fields.Name: EnforceDispatch
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

fields.Name: HasDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

fields.Name: HasDPCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

fields.Name: HasUserDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

fields.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

fields.Name: ParametricDataControl
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

fields.Name: ParametricDataDefType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: CDO Definition Id

fields.Name: PrintingResult
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printing Result

fields.Name: PrintLabels
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic Boolean

fields.Name: ProcessEProcedures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessNCRs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place.
Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

fields.Name: SampleQty
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Sample Qty

fields.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test..  For each  Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured.  Resolved from the Container

fields.Name: SpecFilter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

fields.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

fields.Name: TaskTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

fields.Name: TrainingRequirements
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

fields.Name: TxnDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The date and time the service was performed.  If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

fields.Name: TxnParentServiceName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

fields.Name: TxnServiceSequence
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

fields.Name: WebPart
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Unique name for this instance

fields.Name: ACEMessage
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure)
On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

fields.Name: ACEStatus
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure)
Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.

Value Name                 Meaning
1 ACESuccess after commit event completed successfully
2 ACEFSuccess an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully
3 ACEFFail                 an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event
> 99 <custom status> User specific status codes (Designer based)

fields.Name: ServerName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The server name that processed the transaction.

fields.Name: CurrentDay
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: CurrentMonth
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: CurrentWeekOfYear
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Holds the current week of the year (1-52)

fields.Name: CurrentYear
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic String

fields.Name: SmartBarcode
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Barcode to be parsed using a Smart Scan Rule

fields.Name: SmartScanParseError
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Smart parsing from CLF will not throw an error. If any error does occur, a message will be output here. The calling CLF can decide what to do with it.

fields.Name: SmartScanRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Rule to use for parsing Smart Barcode

fields.Name: StrSplitResult
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Utility field to hold results of string split.

fields.Name: TxnDateGMT
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: TxnDateGMT

fields.Name: DisplayName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

fields.Name: InstanceID
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.

fields.Name: CollectDataPoints
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Collect Data Points transaction is used to collect data points for a trackable object.  It requires that the trackable object have a DataPointCollection assigned to it.

fields.Name: CurrentContainerStatus
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Current status information of a Container

fields.Name: ESigProcessTimerDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement for Process Timer

fields.Name: LiveRelayInfo
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

fields.Name: WIPMsgMgr
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: WIP Message Manager.  Provides functions for retrieval, acknowledgement and writing to history of WIP messages.

fields.Name: ActionDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: List of actions. It's built based on the ActionType field.

fields.Name: ComputationDetail
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Details of the Computation

fields.Name: ESigDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The ESigReqDetail used to fulfill all or part of an ESigRequirement.

fields.Name: LabelSummaries
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: When printing labels, the information needed to print as well as the values (details) are resolved and kept here for use later.

fields.Name: ParametricData
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service.  The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.

fields.Name: SmartScanParseResults
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Holds result of parsing one data value from the Smart Barcode

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DataValue as Boolean.

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to determine the display order in the UI.

fields.Name: Comments
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Notes/Comments

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The name pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: DataPoint
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A single data item to be collected for a DataPointCollectionDef.

fields.Name: DataPointName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The type used to retrieve the Data Point Name, providing a simplified approach for the User Data Collection Definition API

fields.Name: DataType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The DataType pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: DataValue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The actual value collected as a string.  This value is coerced to the value fields for the other data types.

fields.Name: DecimalScale
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Decimal Scale

fields.Name: DecimalValue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DataValue as Decimal.

fields.Name: DisplayLimits
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The DisplayLimits pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: DisplayMode
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
Identifies the type of the Control Display Mode
1 = DropDown
2 = PickList
4 = None

fields.Name: EnumerationValue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Enumeration

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DataValue as Fixed.

fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DataValue as Float.

fields.Name: IntegerValue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: DataValue as Integer.

fields.Name: IsLimitOverride
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies whether the upper/lower limit validations were overridden.

fields.Name: IsLimitOverrideAllowed
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The IsLimitOverrideAllowed pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: IsLimitViolation
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies whether the DataValue is outside of the limits for the DataPoint.  This is set regardless of whether the IsLimitOverride is set or not.

fields.Name: IsRequired
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The IsRequired pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: LowerLimit
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The LowerLimit pulled from the DataPoint.

fields.Name: MapToUserAttribute
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Controls whether the data point value is mapped to a user attribute

fields.Name: NDOValue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Factory modeling objects that can be uniquely identified by name.

fields.Name: ObjectRefType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
Identifies the type of object for the Data Point Collection Def
1 = NDO
2 = RDO
5 = Enumeration

This is for use by the Web client to determine what type of control to use for the DataValue for object types.

fields.Name: ObjectValueCDOType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The name of the ObjectType identified in the Object Data Point.  This is for use by the Web client to put a caption on the DataValue field for object data types.

1 = Round Down (Floor)
2 = Round Up (Ceiling)
3 = Round to Nearest
